limitations: No causal attribution from these observational associations.
Overlapping windows and pairing contexts are dependent; no window-level significance tests.
Device, distance and simultaneous vehicle counts are not systematically annotated.
Mean logit contributions describe individual linear probes, not calibrated probabilities or causal sound components.
Fixed-0.5 fusion is a post-hoc diagnostic, not a replacement selected model.
native_reproduction: all 35 folds, all three models, exact window recalls

The 01:02-01:03 boundary gap and 01:05-end remain excluded. No speech, music, or weapons were present. Per-segment vehicle identity is preserved in notes because the current segment schema labels operating condition but not model.
